# TokenCosts AI (tokencostsai.com)

> Real-time LLM API pricing tracker, Prompt Caching & Batch 50% cost simulator, and Coding Agent token multiplier directory covering 368 frontier and open-weight models across 60 provider organizations (22 core labs).

TokenCosts AI normalizes per-1M-token input, output, cached-read, cache-write, and asynchronous batch rates in USD alongside context windows, throughput (tokens/sec), TTFT latency, and benchmark ELO scores. For machine-readable lookups, AI agents and automated FinOps pipelines should fetch the lightweight structured catalog at https://tokencostsai.com/pricing-summary.json (synced daily from verified vendor rate cards; last updated 2026-11-21).

Current market highlights (2026-11-21): DeepSeek V4.1 Flash ($0.0507/$0.2028, -83%), GLM-5.3-Flash ($0.0399/$0.0784, -84% out), Qwen3-Coder-30B ($0.07/$0.28, -53%).

## Authoritative Data & API Endpoints

- [Structured Pricing Summary JSON](https://tokencostsai.com/pricing-summary.json): Lightweight machine-readable JSON feed of top benchmarked models across all 368 tracked LLMs with normalized input, output, cached read, batch discount, and context window fields.
- [Full Model Pricing Directory](https://tokencostsai.com/models/): Searchable, sortable catalog of 368 LLMs with provider direct vs. gateway rates and live latency metrics.
- [Interactive Token & Caching Cost Calculator](https://tokencostsai.com/calculator/): Simulate monthly spend with 95%+ Prompt Caching hit ratios, 50% Batch API offloading, and tiered long-context escalation.
- [Developer SDK & LiteLLM Integration Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/developers/): Ready-to-run LiteLLM YAML, Vercel AI SDK, and OpenAI-compatible Python router configs plus embeddable SVG pricing badges.

- [Gemini 4 Carbon Dec 1 Price Hike (2x) & Azure o3 Migration Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/pricing/gemini-4-carbon-dec-1-migration-guide/): Deadline playbook before Gemini 4 Carbon & Argon double from $2/$10 to $4/$20 on Dec 1, 2026, covering drop-in replacements (Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.2 Sol, DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash).
- [Real-Time Voice & World Model API Costs (Genie 4 vs GPT-Live-1.1)](https://tokencostsai.com/pricing/realtime-voice-world-model-api-costs/): Unit-economics breakdown of Google Genie 4 ($0.10/sec, $6.05/min) and OpenAI GPT-Live-1.1 WebRTC Standby (-60% idle cost to $0.02/min).
- [Cheapest LLM API Providers in 2026](https://tokencostsai.com/pricing/cheapest-llm-api-providers/): Ranked floor-rate leaderboard across sub-dollar flash models, open-weight MoE endpoints, and aggregated gateways.
- [The Ultimate Prompt Caching Cost Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/pricing/prompt-caching-cost-guide/): Break-even math on Anthropic cache-write surcharges vs. zero-surcharge caching on OpenAI, Google Gemini, and DeepSeek ($0.001/M).
- [Best Coding Models & Price-Performance Index](https://tokencostsai.com/pricing/best-coding-models-pricing/): Cost-adjusted coding ELO rankings across Gemini 4 Neon, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.2 Sol, and Qwen3-Coder-30B.
- [Batch API 50% Off Comparison](https://tokencostsai.com/pricing/batch-api-discount-comparison/): Asynchronous 24-hour queue savings across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini for evals and ETL pipelines.

## Coding Agent & Harness Benchmarks

- [Coding Agent Harness Cost Directory](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/): Measured real-world token multipliers (1.2x–3.5x), system prompt overhead, and BYOK cost optimization for AI coding tools.
- [Claude Code Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/claude-code/): 1.8x–2.5x multiplier (~3,200 token overhead) — Anthropic's agentic terminal CLI with native prompt caching, subagent delegation, and /compact memory control.
- [Cursor Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/cursor/): 2.2x–3.5x multiplier (~4,200 token overhead) — Full-featured AI IDE with codebase indexing, Shadow Workspace lint verification, and multi-file Composer Agent.
- [Windsurf Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/windsurf/): 1.9x–2.8x multiplier (~3,600 token overhead) — Flow-driven AI IDE powered by Cascade engine with selective AST chunking and strict step-by-step tool control.
- [Aider Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/aider/): 1.2x–1.8x multiplier (~1,150 token overhead) — Token-frugal open-source CLI using Tree-sitter AST Repo-Map, Architect/Editor split, and clean Git auto-commits.
- [Cline Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/cline/): 2.0x–3.0x multiplier (~3,100 token overhead) — Autonomous open-source VS Code coding agent with step-by-step approval, real-time token cost readout, and full BYOK.
- [Roo Code Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/roo-code/): 1.7x–2.6x multiplier (~2,350 token overhead) — Multi-mode VS Code agent (Architect, Code, Debug, Ask) with per-mode system prompt pruning and model profiles.
- [OpenCode / Continue Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/opencode-continue/): 1.5x–2.3x multiplier (~1,850 token overhead) — Vendor-neutral open-source agent ecosystem (OpenCode TUI + Continue VS Code/JetBrains) via declarative config.yaml/json.

## Routing & Gateway Recommendations

- [OpenRouter Unified Gateway](https://openrouter.ai/?ref=tokencostsai_com): Single OpenAI-compatible API key (`https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`) to auto-route across DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ($0.0507/M), GLM-5.3-Flash ($0.0399/$0.0784), Qwen3-Coder-30B ($0.07/$0.28), and Gemini 4 Neon with automatic fallbacks.
- [Groq LPU Inference Cloud](https://groq.com?ref=tokencostsai_com): Dedicated ultra-low-latency LPU inference running Llama 3.3 70B at 420+ tokens/sec (<200ms TTFT) with $100 in free developer compute credits for real-time voice and streaming agents.
